summary: Fully audited and corrected EKS creation methods, credentials/networking, native Auto Mode IaC, access, validation, upgrades and cleanup in both languages.
findings: Read all original 1368 lines in each language; preserved all twelve top-level sections and paired code content.
Replaced mandatory wildcard-admin policy with scoped provisioning guidance; corrected architecture-specific client installation, checksum gates, SSO guidance and EKS-compatible client baseline.
Fixed legacy VPC-tag/internet requirements, eksctl fargateProfiles shape, AL2023 selection, overlapping Auto Mode add-ons and unscoped kubeconfig handling.
Corrected AWS create-cluster field names and all three required Auto Mode capability flags, bootstrap settings, IAM roles and asynchronous readiness steps.
Replaced broken Lambda-based CDK custom resource with native aws-eks-v2. Explicit roles use current BlockStoragePolicyV2; no old policy is injected.
Completed Terraform configuration for Auto Mode and conventional MNG alternatives, IAM dependencies, access entries and network preconditions; marked runtime assumptions unverified.

Corrected NodePool expiration vs upgrade cycles; retained p3 because current AWS support catalog includes it. Fixed ContainerInsights metric namespace and removed unverified automatic-collection claims.
Replaced aws-auth overwrite/system:masters example with scoped reader access entry/RBAC; added namespace ownership guards, readiness checks and ClusterIP validation.

Updated upgrade/conditional seven-day rollback guidance and cleanup ordering, ownership checks, waiters, remaining-resource checks and failure gates. No force bypass or fabricated runtime/benchmark results.
validation: Across both locales: 70 Bash blocks, 8 native Kubernetes objects, 8 eksctl configs, 2 NodePool CRDs, 6 HCL blocks and 4 TypeScript blocks; normalized code parity passed.
CDK library2.269.0/TypeScript5.9.3 compile and offline six-resource synthesis passed. Both files also compile under CLI2.1141.0 NodeNext/isolatedModules options; no init/bootstrap/deploy executed.
Terraform1.15.7 + signed AWS provider6.64.0 validate passed with zero errors/warnings. No plan/apply or AWS resource API calls.
Eight mocked installer cases and seven mocked cleanup cases passed, including corrupt/missing hashes, failed namespace deletion, mismatched identities, remaining resources and failed listing.

Korean H2/H3 replacement collision was detected and repaired before completion. Original HEAD hash matched the full-read baseline; all twelve H2 sections and every code block were restored and checked against English.
Scoped git diff --check passed. No actual client installation, cluster provisioning, application/load test, upgrade/rollback or deletion was performed.
